desc: Ruger Phoenix Lockable Hard-shell Handgun Case is what every handgun owner needs to protect their favorite handgun. Features a thermo-molded exoskeleton with a micro egg crate foam interior, providing exceptional versatility while protecting firearms and optics from bumps and shocks. Meticulously constructed with a molded design, the carrying handles provide heavy-duty gripping action to conquer all weather conditions and help fight fatigue. The handgun case is designed with high-quality lockable zippers to ensure your firearm is safely secured when transporting your weapon. The Ruger Phoenix Lockable Hard-shell Handgun Case features a custom metal Ruger nameplate on the front of the protective case.
